extraction_notes: The capacitance curve is digitized from the plotted 0 V bias family curve on p. 3; it is not a tabulated MMSZ5246BS-only capacitance value.
The family graph includes typical capacitance curves but the electrical-characteristics table publishes no capacitance value for the individual part, so the capacitance spec field remains null.
The datasheet publishes zener impedance but the extraction schema has no zener-impedance field.
